comment: OpusOS → Listmonk templates. Import: Listmonk UI → Templates → Import (one .zip per template OR use these bodies). Transactional sends use template_body over API when template_id not set — these are the canonical branded bodies.

templates.name: doc-optin
templates.subject: Confirm your subscription — Opus Overseas
templates.body:
One last step!

Hi {{ .Subscriber.Name }},

Please confirm you want to hear from Opus Overseas. This is required by our DPDP consent process.

Confirm my subscription

You received this because your details were submitted through opusoverseas.in. If this wasn't you, ignore this email.

templates.name: doc-receipt
templates.subject: Payment receipt — Opus Overseas
templates.body:
Thank you, {{ .Tx.Data.name }}!

We have received your payment of ₹{{ .Tx.Data.amount }} for {{ .Tx.Data.service }}.

Reference: {{ .Tx.Data.reference }}

Opus Overseas · Telangana, India

templates.name: doc-agreement
templates.subject: Your service agreement is signed
templates.body:
Signed and sealed, {{ .Tx.Data.name }}

Your service agreement ({{ .Tx.Data.agreementId }}) with Opus Overseas has been executed via {{ .Tx.Data.method }}.

We are starting delivery. Reply to this email if anything needs adjusting.

This is a transactional message — you won't receive marketing from this address without separate consent.

templates.name: doc-otp
templates.subject: Your one-time code
templates.body:
Verification code

Your Opus Overseas code is {{ .Tx.Data.code }}

It expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request this, ignore it.

templates.name: nurture-value
templates.description: Nurture touch 1 — value (marketing list; needs explicit marketing consent)
templates.subject: No pressure {{ .Subscriber.Name }}, just an idea
templates.body:
Hi {{ .Subscriber.Name }},

You were curious about services from Opus Overseas — here's one useful guide we thought you'd like.

Read the guide

templates.name: nurture-final
templates.subject: Last note unless you want more, {{ .Subscriber.Name }}
templates.body:
Hi {{ .Subscriber.Name }},

We'll stop here unless you'd like more help. Reply to this email any time when you're ready — no pressure.

Unsubscribe
